title: Speculative decoding over PCIe: MTP3 (draft 3) vs DFlash2 (draft 7) — longer drafts did not help

workload.server_notes: 4096-token prefill budget, 32 concurrent slots, FP8 KV cache, GPU-only prefix cache

variance.note: five independent cold-start C1 checks; ~±5% between starts

methodology: per cell: 5 warmed-up 30-second windows; C8 is the aggregate

source.project: Local Inference Lab (local-inference-lab/rtx6kpro, GLM-5.3-Flash model page)

transferable: On this hardware, raising the draft from 3 to 7 tokens brought no gain — speculative decoding is bandwidth-bound over PCIe. Start at draft 2-3 and measure.
not_transferable: The concrete numbers, and '3 beats 7' as a general rule — they depend on this model, this quantisation and this hardware combination.
